sentences.en: At that time she was engaged in operating a tractor.
sentences.zh: 那时她正在操作拖拉机。

sentences.en: When chickens pancake-shape maintain, the tractor must have won again.
sentences.zh: 当鸡们呈煎饼状时，拖拉机又赢了。

sentences.en: Today's modern tractors and combines are equipped with high technology.
sentences.zh: 现在的拖拉机和联合收割机配备了高科技。
